name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition datasheet
notes: Vendor primary specification document. Figures transcribed verbatim from the document's spec table; any vendor marketing precision labels (e.g. 'AI TOPS') keep their vendor definition in the referencing accelerator's notes. | API ROWS ARE A DOCUMENTATION DEFECT, DO NOT CITE AS A CAPABILITY CEILING (verified 2026-10-04 by re-downloading doc 3519208). This sheet prints 'Graphics APIs DirectX 12, Shader Model 6.6, OpenGL 4.63, Vulkan 1.33' and 'Compute APIs CUDA 11.6, OpenCL 3.0, DirectCompute', while the newer RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell sheet (doc 5108623, Apr26) prints 'OpenGL 4.63, Vulkan 1.43' and 'CUDA 12.8' for the SAME architecture. The RTX 6000 ADA Generation sheet (doc 2504660) also prints 'CUDA 11.6', so this string is copy-paste from an Ada-era template NVIDIA never updated. It is a stale DOCUMENT row, not a hardware difference - do not read CUDA 11.6 or Vulkan 1.33 off this sheet as a limit on what the RTX PRO 6000 runs. Evidence and the full comparison: w3s-nv-rtx-pro-6000-and-4500-api-row-stale-in-6000-sheet.
